Source: [src/Meridian.Ui.Shared/Endpoints/WorkstationEndpoints.ScopeOptions.cs:50](../../../../src/Meridian.Ui.Shared/Endpoints/WorkstationEndpoints.ScopeOptions.cs#L50).

Operating-scope options (P4): the entities, funds and fund accounts the calling operator may scope the workstation to, for the scope picker and the scope bar&#x27;s names. The route is open to any authenticated workstation operator, but the payload is not: it carries only nodes the caller could already read through an existing route, decided by the same scoped grants those routes use (EndpointAuthorization.AuthorizeScopedManyAsync, which resolves account → fund → business → organization ancestry). A node is visible when the caller holds one of these permissions globally and a scoped assignment grants it at that node or an ancestor: UserPermission.ManageFundStructure for legal entities, funds and accounts (the /api/fund-structure/graph response guard); UserPermission.ManageDirectLending for accounts (the fund-account reads in FundAccountEndpoints, which return a fund&#x27;s accounts but not the fund record); UserPermission.ViewTrades for accounts (the brokerage household and portfolio-aggregation reads); UserPermission.ViewLedgerReports or UserPermission.ManageLedgerReports for legal entities (the entity timeline). UserPermission.AdminMaintenance sees every node, as on the graph. Tenant isolation is the fund-structure service&#x27;s own: it serves only the caller&#x27;s tenant snapshot and refuses an unresolvable tenant, which the API exception handler reports as 403. A relationship that would name a fund or entity outside the visible set is dropped rather than disclosed. When an account&#x27;s fund or entity is dropped that way, the account carries WorkstationScopeAccountOptionDto.FundWithheld or WorkstationScopeAccountOptionDto.EntityWithheld instead, so a client can say &quot;not visible to you&quot; rather than &quot;none recorded&quot;. The flag discloses only that the account has an active fund or entity the caller cannot see: never its id, name, or anything else about it, and nothing about nodes not related to an account the caller may already see. It is false when the account has no such relationship, or when the relationship points at a node absent from the active structure (which no caller, an administrator included, could be shown).

One snapshot build is shared across all subscribers of a topic, and the market-data ingestion hot path is untouched.

## WorkstationFundScopeTenantAccessor

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Ui.Shared.Endpoints.WorkstationFundScopeTenantAccessor</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Ui.Shared/Endpoints/WorkstationTenantContext.cs:106](../../../../src/Meridian.Ui.Shared/Endpoints/WorkstationTenantContext.cs#L106).

SEC-005 slice 4c-ii: supplies the storage layer (which must not depend on ASP.NET Core) with the caller&#x27;s server-resolved tenant for the current request, so the Postgres ledger store can apply tenant read predicates without threading a caller-tenant argument through every read method. Depends only on the singleton-safe IHttpContextAccessor (AsyncLocal-backed), so it is safe to inject into the singleton ledger store without a captive scoped dependency. Returns null when the request has no concrete tenant; strict stores reject that unresolved authority.
